name: Yanezutai no Kimi e
source:
The protagonist Kishida Kunihiko is enjoying his time as a student. One day, he has a dream. It's a dream about a girl, bathed in moonlight and looking sadly up at the moon. It feels like she's saying something to Kunihiko, but he can't hear her voice. A few days later while he's walking with his junior Nagasawa Yuki, he notices a woman looking at him.

The woman is staring at his cellphone... or rather, the small glass bead on his cellphone strap.

That night Kunihiko has another dream.
A dream about a girl.
A girl was bullied by those around her, always crying on the roof.
And how he had always wanted to make that crying girl smile.
The girl was the one who had given him the little glass bead...

When he wakes up, Kunihiko opens his window to look at the place the girl used to cry. It was his neighbor's roof where the girl was always crying, looking up at the moon. When he turns his gaze to that spot, the woman from that afternoon is there. 

Kunihiko calls the name of the girl who spent her youth bullied and weeping... "Inori".
When he does she smiles and climbs into his room through the window. She kisses him and asks Kunihiko-

"...Hey, do you want to have sex?"

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=199981]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
主人公岸田邦彦正享受着学生生活。某天，他做了一个梦。梦中，一名沐浴在月光下的少女悲伤地仰望月亮。她似乎在对邦彦说些什么，他却听不见她的声音。几天后，邦彦与学妹长泽有纪同行时，注意到一名女子正在看着自己。

女子凝视着他的手机……更准确地说，是手机挂绳上的那颗小玻璃珠。

当天夜里，邦彦又做了一个梦。
关于一名少女的梦。
少女受到周围众人的欺凌，总是在屋顶哭泣。
而他一直想让那名哭泣的少女露出笑容。
那颗小玻璃珠，正是少女送给他的……

醒来后，邦彦打开窗户，望向少女曾经哭泣的地方。那是邻居家的屋顶，少女总在那里哭着仰望月亮。他把目光投向那里，发现下午遇见的女子正站在屋顶上。

邦彦呼唤那个青春岁月饱受欺凌、终日哭泣的少女之名……“祈”。
听见呼唤后，她露出微笑，从窗户爬进邦彦的房间。她吻了他，并问邦彦——

“……喂，要做爱吗？”
